# acciddasuite

`acciddasuite` provides a complete pipeline for infectious diseases
forecasts. It fetches
([`get_data()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_data.md))
and validates input data
([`check_data()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/check_data.md)),
optionally applies nowcasting to adjust for reporting delays
([`get_ncast()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_ncast.md)),
evaluates models by cross-validation
([`get_cv()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_cv.md)),
and generates forecasts
([`get_fcast()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_fcast.md)).

## Installation

You can install the development version of acciddasuite from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
# pak::pak("ACCIDDA/acciddasuite")
```

## Example

``` r

library(acciddasuite)
tail(example_data)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   as_of      location target            target_end_date observation
#>   <date>     <chr>    <chr>             <date>                <dbl>
#> 1 2026-07-05 CA       wk inc covid hosp 2026-07-04              152
#> 2 2026-07-12 CA       wk inc covid hosp 2026-07-04              161
#> 3 2026-07-05 NY       wk inc covid hosp 2026-07-04               59
#> 4 2026-07-12 NY       wk inc covid hosp 2026-07-04               60
#> 5 2026-07-12 CA       wk inc covid hosp 2026-07-11              168
#> 6 2026-07-12 NY       wk inc covid hosp 2026-07-11               51
```

``` r

fcast <- example_data |>
  check_data() |>
  get_ncast() |>
  get_cv(eval_start_date = max(example_data$target_end_date) - 30) |>
  get_fcast(top_n = 3)
#> ℹ Using max_delay = 6 from data
#> ℹ Truncating from max_delay = 6 to 2.
#> ℹ Using max_delay = 6 from data
#> ℹ Truncating from max_delay = 6 to 2.
#> [2026-07-27 13:39:59.502] get_cv: +1.0134 secs
#> [2026-07-27 13:40:00.526] get_fcast: +4.9910 secs

fcast
#> <accidda_fcast>
#> Target:   wk inc covid hosp
#> Series:   2 (location)
#> Forecast: 2026-07-18 to 2026-08-08 (h = 4)
#> Models:   3 + ENSEMBLE

fcast |> autoplot()
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-4-1.png)

Save to [myRespiLens](https://www.respilens.com/myrespilens) format:

``` r

# to_respilens(fcast, path = "respilens.json")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`EPIESTIM()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/EPIESTIM.md)
  : EpiEstim model for fable

- [`FOUNDATION()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/FOUNDATION.md)
  : Forecast with a pretrained time-series model

- [`as_tibble(`*`<accidda_data>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/as_tibble.accidda_data.md)
  [`as_tibble(`*`<accidda_ncast>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/as_tibble.accidda_data.md)
  [`as_tibble(`*`<accidda_fcast>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/as_tibble.accidda_data.md)
  : Plot-ready tibbles from pipeline objects

- [`autoplot(`*`<accidda_cv>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/autoplot.accidda_cv.md)
  : Plot cross-validation model rankings

- [`autoplot(`*`<accidda_data>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/autoplot.accidda_data.md)
  : Plot surveillance data

- [`autoplot(`*`<accidda_fcast>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/autoplot.accidda_fcast.md)
  : Plot a forecast

- [`autoplot(`*`<accidda_ncast>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/autoplot.accidda_ncast.md)
  : Plot a nowcast

- [`check_data()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/check_data.md)
  : Validate surveillance data

- [`default_models()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/default_models.md)
  : Default forecasting models

- [`example_data`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/example_data.md)
  : Weekly COVID-19 hospital admissions for New York and California

- [`get_cv()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_cv.md)
  : Cross-validate forecasting models

- [`get_data()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_data.md)
  : Fetch hospitalisation data

- [`get_fcast()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_fcast.md)
  : Produce a forward forecast

- [`get_ncast()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/get_ncast.md)
  : Nowcast right-truncated surveillance data

- [`print(`*`<accidda_cv>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/print.accidda_cv.md)
  :

  Print an `accidda_cv` object

- [`print(`*`<accidda_data>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/print.accidda_data.md)
  :

  Print an `accidda_data` object

- [`print(`*`<accidda_fcast>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/print.accidda_fcast.md)
  :

  Print an `accidda_fcast` object

- [`print(`*`<accidda_ncast>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/print.accidda_ncast.md)
  :

  Print an `accidda_ncast` object

- [`to_respilens()`](https://accidda.github.io/acciddasuite/reference/to_respilens.md)
  : Convert a forecast to RespiLens format
